title: Track 1 baseline archive and canonical index

inventory.approach: an index and a manifest instead of editing history - the brief's preference, and it keeps every original readable as written

verification_of_the_brief.why: the brief hands over the numbers to publish. It is a hand-off, not a source. Publishing a retyped figure into the file everyone quotes from is exactly how a wrong number becomes canonical
verification_of_the_brief.method: compared field by field against the Stage 5ZZZ-N artifact on disk

discrepancy_found.what: the brief labels +18,429 / +3,906 / -464 'Swing contribution'. Those are the Swing CLUSTER P&L (pnl_by_cluster.roska4_swing), not the marginal contribution
discrepancy_found.why_it_matters: they answer different questions and differ by ~$1,000 on the floor. The 2026 figure is negative on both and WORSE on the marginal one (-626 against -464), which is the one that answers 'what does Swing add?'
discrepancy_found.resolution: the index publishes BOTH, labelled, side by side

verification_of_the_brief.arithmetic_self_check: the four cluster P&Ls sum exactly to the full-stack net in all three windows

canonical_to_quote.holds: Part A reference and Part B live-tradable selected, reproduced from code
the signed paper-scope decision; grants nothing
legacy retirement only; carries NO order-approval field
the reconciliation of all of the above - the file to quote

high_risk_files_named.why_not_quote_directly: contains the same-day variant alongside D-1. The same-day column needs the 16:00 close and cannot exist during the 14:05-15:55 Swing window, so it is not tradable
narrow D-1 retune (ema=10). Measured, NOT promoted - quoting it as a baseline would publish a parameter the route does not run
full D-1 grid. Its winner was NOT promoted, and its apparatus concern was resolved by Stage 5ZZZ-M
SPY intraday regime proxy - research only, not selected for paper
ES intraday proxy label-recovery test - not a trading backtest, nothing promoted
root cause of the ema 30->50 substitution. Explains WHY the selected identity is 'old/effective ema=50'; not itself a baseline

superseded_classes.pre_B1_blocker_lists: SUPERSEDED - B1 was signed 2026-08-27; suites written before that date still assert the confirmation file does not exist
superseded_classes.stale_slot_count_docs: SUPERSEDED - the Track 1 slot table is 71, and older documents and tests still say 70
superseded_classes.stage_5ZZZ_L_apparatus_concern: SUPERSEDED by Stage 5ZZZ-M, which found the cause was an unrecorded ema 30->50 substitution in the regeneration wrapper
superseded_classes.old_dashboard_wording_docs: SUPERSEDED by Stages 5ZZZ-F and 5ZZZ-S, which changed the market-view contract and the panel states
superseded_classes.same_day_swing_reports: REFERENCE_ONLY - real numbers, not attainable, because the label needs a close that has not happened at decide time

paper_scope.note: Paper SCOPE only. No entry here releases a gate, satisfies PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE, or promotes a parameter.

remaining_blocker_before_paper.requires: 5 judgeable days, 0 failing days allowed, complete Calm decision evidence
remaining_blocker_before_paper.current_obstacle: every day in the qualifying window was recorded BEFORE the Stage 5ZZZ-Q Swing fix, so the window cannot be entirely post-fix until five post-fix trading days have run

checks: every net and maxdd in the artifact appears in the index
BOTH swing cluster P&L and marginal figures are published
historical baseline marked reference-only and not live-tradable
selected baseline marked live-tradable and operator-chosen
swing identity is causal D-1 old/effective ema=50
the index never says same-day Swing is tradable
the index never claims orders are possible
every classification is one of the ten allowed
every non-canonical row carries a why-not-quote reason
every file the index points at actually exists
